source: RabenDesign module (Marketplace), demo app RabenDesignSystem at c8db48a (2026-10-28)
instructions:
## Raben: how a mockup is written

- Use the class names of the module (Atlas + Raben): `card`, `btn btn-primary`, `form-group`, `form-control`, `table`, `badge badge-*`, `nav-tabs`, `alert alert-*`, `rb-header` with `rb-logo`, `rb-kpi`, `raben-layout` with `raben-sidebar`, `raben-topbar`, `raben-content`.
- The look: Barlow, brand red #E30311, grey #F7F7F7 page, white cards, 1px #E6E6E6 lines, 4–8px corners.
- Kit 1.0.0, made from the RabenDesign module as the demo app RabenDesignSystem at commit c8db48a (2026-10-28). When the module changes, the kit is updated in the raben-app skill (reference/design-kit.json) and imported into the Team server again.
